name: dimension_pack
summary: The audit layer that makes every chain entry queryable in all five canonical frames simultaneously (vector / circle / hex / rgb / fps) without re-computation. Sidecar — does NOT enter canonical_json, so v1 chain verification is unchanged. Built 2026-05-28 in response to Tom's directive 'make sure we are always mapping vector circle hexidecimal rgb fps' after the cycle_4 loop traversal identified rgb under-threading + fps under-quantization gaps. Retroactive: audit_chain() applies the 5-tuple to existing entries.
engine_pattern: Pure-math stdlib module. emit(record) -> DimensionPack with: vector_hex_64 (first 64 chars of multi_layer_hex.pack_layers), circle_motif_id (recursive_workflows match — which SCC/cycle this event closes into; '*' if leaf), crystal_hex (the InferenceRecord's anchor), rgba (deterministic 4-float color from HSV(hue_from_sub_dag, saturation_from_cost_class, value_from_tier)), frame_pack (timestamp quantized at all 5 canonical FPS simultaneously). Same inputs always produce same pack across runs/machines.

five_canonical_frames.vector: multi_layer_hex.pack_layers slot 0 (sentence axis, 32 bytes); fallback SHA-256 of canonical record JSON
five_canonical_frames.circle: recursive_workflows match against persisted SCCs/cycles/motifs in studio/assets/_recursions/; '*' if event is a leaf (not yet part of any detected closed loop)
five_canonical_frames.rgb: HSV→RGB derived from (sub_dag_hue, cost_class_saturation, tier_value) — 6 sub_dag hues + 9 cost_class saturations + 26 tier values locked
five_canonical_frames.fps: frame_clock.timestamp_to_frame for all 5 canonical FPS (24/30/60/90/120) simultaneously; stdlib floor(ts*fps) fallback if frame_clock import fails

graceful_fallbacks: multi_layer_hex unimportable → SHA-256 of canonical JSON (still deterministic)
All fallbacks deterministic — pack content stable across environments
substrate: Sidecar JSON files at ~/.cc/dimension_packs/<crystal_short>.json (optional; never automatic). Does NOT modify ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl or any existing record.

inbound_callers: core/lib/inference_logger.py (future: call dimension_pack.emit after log() returns crystal_id)
studio/docs/LOOP-FOUR-DAG.svg renderer (dag_render.py — future: use deterministic_rgba instead of hardcoded sub_dag colors)

guarantees: Determinism — same (tier, cost_class, sub_dag, ts) always produces the same pack across machines and runs
Non-invasive — does NOT modify InferenceRecord, canonical_json, or any existing record
Retroactive — audit_chain() backfills the 5-tuple for entries created BEFORE this module landed
Sub-DAG-aware — sub_dag inferred from tier if not provided (_TIER_TO_SUB_DAG mapping covers all 26 active tiers)
All 5 frames always populated — graceful fallbacks ensure no None / missing values; circle_motif uses '*' for leaves
Stdlib only — math + hashlib + json + dataclasses + pathlib; no numpy, no scipy, no scikit-learn
Cheap — typical pack emission ~0.3ms in the smoke (mostly the recursion scan; cacheable)
usage_example:
# After inference_logger.log() returns the crystal_id:
from dimension_pack import emit, save_pack
pack = emit(record_dict, crystal_id=crystal)
# Optional sidecar persistence:
save_pack(pack)
# Or just read the 5 fields directly:
print(pack.vector_hex_64, pack.circle_motif_id, pack.crystal_hex, pack.rgba, pack.frame_pack)

# Retroactive audit of the existing chain:
from dimension_pack import audit_chain
rows = audit_chain(sample=50)
# rows = [{tier, model, crystal_short, rgba, circle, frame_60fps, vec_head}, ...]
